description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UploadedFileAlreadyMovedException' which extends RuntimeException within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace. It is used to indicate an error condition when an uploaded file has already been moved and cannot be accessed further.

classes.name: UploadedFileAlreadyMovedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that an uploaded file has already been moved and cannot be accessed.
